news.headline: Bridgewater Sees 1-in-3 Odds of a Destabilizing Cyberattack. CrowdStrike’s Workload Is Already “Up 50%”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBridgewater is managing money on a one-in-three chance of an economically destabilizing cyberattack within a year, and incident-response firms are reportedly out of capacity. CrowdStrike’s record $419 million of net new ARR, up 58%, shows the attack surge turning into subscription revenue.

news.headline: Amdocs (DOX) Stock Is Up 4.6% Today Without Company News
news.summary: Amdocs shares rose 4.6% on Wednesday, Nov. 25, without company-specific news, while the S&P 500 and software stocks fell.

news.headline: Satya Nadella Says “the Floor of Cyber Attacks Has Fallen.” Microsoft Just Declared Code Red After a 24-Hour Outage
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft declared a code red after a 24-hour outage hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot, and it wants to fix future global problems within an hour. Satya Nadella says AI has made cyberattacks easier and fixes must go live instantly, making reliability an ongoing cost.
